queries.forge_train_cross_split_identical_consti: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT d.constitution FROM duplicate_constitutions d JOIN targets t USING(constitution) JOIN assignments a USING(target_id) WHERE a.forge_split!='quarantine' GROUP BY d.constitution HAVING max(a.forge_split='train')=1 AND count(DISTINCT a.forge_split)>1)
queries.provider_cross_split_duplicate_constitut: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT d.constitution FROM duplicate_constitutions d JOIN targets t USING(constitution) JOIN assignments a USING(target_id) GROUP BY d.constitution HAVING count(DISTINCT a.provider_split)>1)
